notes.title: Ghost Bear HOT FIX 2 DEPLOYED
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44622047/85075660824426d17cdb0c01956ff915730495ec.jpg[/img]
Greetings, Warriors!
 
We’re actively watching and listening for your feedback on MechWarrior 5: Clans – Ghost Bear: Flash Storm. Our goal is to address any issues as quickly as possible—so keep letting us know what you’re seeing!
Hotfix 1 went out last week to resolve a crash issue, and now we’re rolling out Hotfix 2 with more improvements to enhance your experience.

Hotfix 2 Patch Notes
General Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Elementals would sometimes become non-responsive.
[*] Fixed a progression blocker in Mission 1 if the first jammer was destroyed before the combat scenario started.
[/list]
PC Only:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue when enabling DLSS, XeSS or FSR a value was being set incorrectly causing incorrect results.
[*] Fixed an issue where XeSS settings would reset after disabling it and changing DLSS or FSR settings.
[*] This patch is now live across all platforms.
[/list]

Thanks again for your continued support and feedback. We’ll keep you posted as more fixes roll out!
— The MechWarrior 5: Clans Team
 
Looking Ahead
 
We’re also working on a future patch for MW5: Clans and Ghost Bear, which will include:
[list]
[*] Investigating adding Elemental controls to the Battlegrid.
[*] Investigating a feature allowing the host to pause the game for all players.
[*] A major expansion to the Digital Collector’s Art Book content.
[/list]
Stay tuned for more details on that in the near future!

notes.title: GHOST BEAR: FLASH STORM – HOTFIX INTEL
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44622047/7ec1e0dcb9bf7bf7caf730725052c2bcb7d19bc8.jpg[/img]

Greetings Warriors,

We’ve been watching your gameplay, reading your feedback, and digging into your reported issues. Thanks for taking the time to share — we’re listening and acting fast.

A few major bugs have stood out, so we’re rolling out a two-stage hotfix to address them.

HOTFIX 1 – ETA: Tonight / Early Tomorrow (May 9)

FIXED – FSR Crash
We’ve resolved a crash issue related to FSR and global illumination. The fix has been tested and confirmed, and we're planning to deploy the patch for Steam players tonight.
Until then a temporary workaround is available in your graphics options by setting Global illumination to medium

HOTFIX 2 – ETA: Mid Next Week (May 14)

IMPROVEMENT – Elementals Getting Stuck
We’ve identified and addressed an issue where Elementals could become unresponsive or stuck during missions.

Coming Soon: 
We’re also collecting additional improvements for the MW5: Clans and Ghost Bear, and those will be rolling in a Update Patch
[list]
[*] We are investigating adding Elemental controls to the Battlegrid
[*] Investigating adding a Feature to allow Host to pause the game for all players 
[*] Major Expansion to the Digital Collectors Art Book Content 
[*] More details on that patch are coming soon — stay tuned.
[/list]

Thanks again for your continued support and feedback. We’ll keep you updated as fixes roll out!
— The MechWarrior 5 Clans Team

notes.title: Ghost Bear Flash Storm Information
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44622047/3b73fb9aa986ee4e83b630ebad824f1802bc7fb9.jpg[/img]

Greetings Warriors,
We are excited to announce the full release Date for MechWarrior 5: Clans - Ghost Bear: Flash Storm DLC!  You will be able to purchase and play MechWarrior 5: Clans - Ghost Bear: Flash Storm

RELEASE DATE
May 7th at 5 PM PDT, 8 PM EDT.( May 8th 00:00 UTC)

We originally projected our release date to fall just inside the month of April, but we wanted a bit more time to deliver an exciting expansion that is worthy of Clan Ghost Bear name! We have locked in our release date to the beginning of May. The entire team is grateful to the fan response to the announcement and we look forward to watching you play and hearing your feedback

FREE UPDATE DETAILS

We also wanted to take this opportunity to give you more details on the Free Updates! 
The Free updates section on the DLC PAGE was still a work in progress when we announced the DLC but now we have more Details on key updates.
On May 8th we’ll be delivering the second free update to MechWarrior 5: Clans featuring:

Mechlab Usability Overhaul 
[list]
[*] The flow and UI has been revised to make Omnipod swaps and unlocks much more intuitive. Players can clearly see which Omnipod sets are available and can mix and match Omnipod components to create all manner of custom builds. It’s also much easier to save out custom presets and restore them in a few clicks. 
[*] A context menu has been added that allows faster direct access to all areas of the mech lab such as Camo Customization, Weapon Groups, or Mech Details.  
[*] Players can now see more details such as stat changes for engine heatsinks. 
[/list]
Progression and Balance pass 
[list]
[*] We’ve rebalanced many of the weapons to make all the different builds more appealing and viable. We have also adjusted Smoke Jaguar progression to incorporate some of the omnipod and mech unlocks from Trials of War to better positions in the progression. 
[/list]
BattleGrid Improvements 
[list]
[*] Battlegrid operates in pause mode in Single Player mode. This allows players breathing time to administer more complex queued orders and makes issuing commands much easier. Pause mode can be toggled to real time with a button press. 
[/list]
More Gamepad Options
[list]
[*] We’ve updated the control options for gamepad with a Mercenaries-like control scheme that no longer requires the use of a weapon toggle. It will appear in Gamepad options as ALT-Config 3. We’ve also added a bunch more re-bindable buttons to the CUSTOM layout so you can remap things like MASC to a face button. 
[/list]
Trials of War is now fully integrated 
[list]
[*] Trial of War is no longer treated as a free DLC and is fully integrated into the game for all players to enjoy. 
[*] Dominion Mode added to Arena. Get the highest score before time expires by capturing and holding the active capture point. Scannable stations can launch artillery strikes against the active capture point. 
[*] 2 New Horde Mode Maps, Starport and Townships, with Light, Medium, Heavy ,and Assault Challenges
[/list]
Option for Friendly Fire 
[list]
[*] Star mates do not cause friendly fire, but we have added an option that disables player driven damage to friendlies. 
[/list]
Performance and Stability 
[list]
[*] Improved performance and stability with many small bug fixes and optimizations. 
[/list]
COMMs Update 
[list]
[*] Pilots now have fully animated faces instead of helmets with mouth coverings. 
[/list]
Audio update 
[list]
[*] Rerecorded and upgraded banter dialog for Mia, Samantha, and Alexander. Added some additional SFX and adjusted mix. 
[/list]
Digital Extras 
[list]
[*] Digital Extras now features full video dioramas of 16 Omnimechs in the Technical Readout Section. 
[/list]
Graphics Options 
We’ve added support for: 
[list]
[*] AMD FSR 3.1 
[*] DLSS 4  
[*] Intel XeSS 
[/list]
Early Access Modding 
[list]
[*] We will be starting the process of releasing the early access editor to a small group of modders to test out the modding pipeline on May 20, 2025. Full mod support is planned to come as soon as the editor is tested and deemed ready for release. 
[/list]

Notes on Ghost Bear Flash Storm DLC
Retroactive Content with Ghost Bear Purchase 
[list]
[*] As per usual Ghost Bear DLC will retroactively add content back into the Smoke Jaguar Campaign. If you purchase Ghost Bear Flash Storm you will have access to the 4 new Omnimechs and 4 new Battlemechs in the Smoke Jaguar Campaign as well as the new BattleMech Mechlab. 
[/list]
DLC SHARING
[list]
[*] All coop players will be able to access all DLC owned by the host so everyone gets to play! 
[/list]

Thank you for purchasing and playing MechWarrior 5: Clans we look forward to sharing more information about Ghost Bear Flash Storm in April!

The MechWarrior 5: Clans Team

notes.title: MW5 CLANS HOT FIX #3 PREVIEW
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44622047/5620be6c1a6203feb4d7908e64c11cfc6b399f67.jpg[/img]

Greetings Warriors,

We have another hot-fix patch in certification that we will be releasing early next week! 
We truely appreciate all the support and feedback. If you are experiencing any issues please email Support at (mw5clans@piranhagames.zendesk.com).

We look forward to sharing details on what is next for MW5 Clans.

The MechWarrior Clans Team.

Features:
[list]
[*] Added the ability for Co-Op players to take over AI 'Mechs while spectating[*] 
[*] Design note: Swap functionality for clients does not include usage on the radial menu for this update
[/list]

Fixed Issues:
Co-Op
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where clients could see other player 'Mechs jitter after mission sequences
[*] Fixed an issue where 'Mechs would be missing in the post-mission screen if they were destroyed during the mission
[*] Fixed an issue where client 'Mechs could be rearranged after a mission restart
[*] Fixed an issue where clients could target destroyed Sokol rotors
[*] Fixed issues where the HUD, camera, or player control would sometimes not be restored after using repair bays
[/list]

Platform Specific 
[list]
[*] Added support for Nvidia Reflex and Frame Generation for Microsoft Store users
[*] Fixed a console bug where custom key bindings would not save once the title is restarted
[*] Added support for PlayStation Controllers for Microsoft Store
[/list]

Campaign Missions
[list]
[*] Fixed an area in ‘Reckoning’ where users could fall through the map
[*] Fixed an issue in 'Reckoning' where playing a second time would trigger the wrong cinematics
[*] Fixed an issue in ‘Voices of the Past’ where the hangar door would remain closed if one of your 'Mechs was destroyed 
[*] Fixed a blocker that could occur in ‘A World on Fire’
[/list]

Performance
[list]
[*] Improved overall performance in the first two missions
[*] Improved overall performance in ‘Boxed In’
[/list]

Audio
[list]
[*] Improved the audio quality of Mia’s dialogue for all barks and Santander missions
[/list]

Gameplay
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where weapons could remain disabled after switching 'Mechs with the radial menu open
[*] Fixed instances where menus could overlap if 'Mech was switched while performing other actions
[*] The ‘Doomsday Machine’ achievement/trophy now properly unlocks with the starting 'Mechs (Viper, Arctic Cheetah, Mist Lynx and Kit Fox)
[/list]

UI
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in Archives where viewing consecutive cinematics could cause subtitles to briefly carry over
[*] Fixed an issue where incorrect text was displayed when first entering the Completed Research menu
[*] Fixed an issue where some campaign saves would appear greyed out in the Title Screen
[*] Fixed an issue where keyboard input could stop working if you double-clicked Facilities or a Drop Deck pilot slot
[/list]

Settings
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the FPS limit option would not function
[*] Fixed a typo in the “Invert X-Axis” option
[*] Corrected the keybind listings for Starmate commands
[/list]

Localization
[list]
[*] Improved overall localization for German, Russian, Japanese, and French
[/list]

Known Issues:
[list]
[*] Some trees have the incorrect material in Huntress, the Combat Sim and Shooting Range Sim Pod missions
[*] There are UI bugs when using PlayStation 5 Controllers through the Microsoft Store client
[/list]

notes.title: MechWarrior 5: Clans Hot Fix #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44622047/4404a598968c67ec28f30422336fe01149ea1f4f.jpg[/img]

MechWarrior 5: Clans Hotfix #2 is now live!
We've made a few additions to the patch notes since the preview, so be sure to check out the full details. If you encounter any issues, don’t hesitate to contact support at mw5clans@piranhagames.zendesk.com.

We truly appreciate all the support and feedback we've received and are hard at work on future fixes and more.
The MechWarrior 5: Clans Team.

[h2]Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added an option for Co-Op clients to select their desired pilot
[*] The new menu is available in the Social Menu, allowing clients to swap pilots
[/list]

[h2]Fixed Issues:[/h2]
[b]Co-Op[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the position of a DropShip takeoff in ‘Pirate’s Bay'
[*] Fixed a rare instance where an enemy would not appear in ‘Smuggler's Den'
[*] Fixed an issue with the gate generators on ‘Kishi Kaisei’
[*] Fixed an issue where clients could not walk through certain wall assets destroyed by other clients in ‘A World on Fire’
[*] Fixed an issue for clients in ‘A World on Fire’ where an enemy 'Mech would disappear briefly during a sequence
[*] Fixed an issue where the mission area would close off before all players have left in ‘Hold the Line’
[*] Fixed an issue where the small gate in ‘Jaguar’s Down' would not open for clients
[*] Fixed an issue where clients could not see Chassis Milestone progress
[*] Fixed an issue where clients would sometimes have no HUD after joining mid-mission
[*] Fixed an issue where clients would start missions with the Scan Mode HUD prompt flashing
[*] Fixed an issue where you could get stuck as another pilot in the Star when starting a new campaign, if you had previously played in a co-op session as a client
[*] Fixed some instances where clients would sometimes be stuck in the fade to black state after using a repair bay
[*] Note: Issue may still occur in some instances, which will be fully resolved in a future update. If you encounter the issue, toggling BattleGrid or cycling 'Mech power will resolve it
[/list]

[b]Campaign Missions[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a salvage crate in ‘Combat Patrol’ that was giving incorrect rewards
[*] Fixed an issue in ‘The Golden Forge’ where some 'Mechs were temporarily indestructible 
[*] Fixed a DropShip takeoff sequence in ‘Inspection Duty’
[*] Fixed an issue where certain enemy ‘Mechs would not target you in 'A World on Fire’
[*] Fixed an issue with the ‘Mech cockpit during the intro of 'A World on Fire’
[*] Adjusted objectives at the start of ‘Kishi Kaisei’ so they can no longer be missed
[*] Added proper pilot names when targeting allies in ‘Kishi Kaisei’
[*] Reduced the chances of critical explosion for a 'Mech in ‘Kishi Kaisei’
[*] Changed all ally ‘Mechs in 'Traffickers’ to use the correct camo pattern
[*] Reduced the chances allied 'Mech can get caught on terrain in ‘Pirate’s Bay'
[*] Fixed an issue where clients could trigger an event in ‘Reckoning’ that only the host should be able to trigger
[*] Fixed Jayden’s helmet in his communication pips in the first mission 
[*] Fixed an issue where some enemy assault ‘Mechs stopped moving and attacking the player in 'Security Protocols’
[*] Buffed an enemy 'Mech in ‘No Stone Unturned’
[*] ‘Trial of Position’ difficulty has been slightly reduced
[*] ‘A World of Fire’ difficulty has been slightly reduced
[*] 'Crater Investigation’ difficulty has been slightly reduced
[*] ‘Disciplinary Action’ difficulty has been slightly reduced
[*] Lowered the enemy tonnage and increased ally tonnage in the final fight of 'Heir to the Dragon'
[*] Reduced the health of the Sokol and its thrusters in ‘Target Acquisition’ 
[*] Reduced the health of Union turrets in ‘Heir to the Dragon’ and ‘Crater Investigation’
[/list]

[b]Art[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved the texture of the large trees on Huntress
[*] Adjusted the flamer VFX orientation so the origin point appears correct
[/list]

[b]Audio[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where certain sounds were temporarily ducked or absent at the start of the first mission
[*] Fixed an instance where Naomi would repeat the same line twice in a row in ‘No Stone Unturned’
[*] Added a cooldown to BBs ‘Scan Mode Engaged/Disengaged’ audio events
[*] Added SFX to the pause menu and command wheel buttons
[*] Added SFX when using the weapon group menu and adjusted the loud audio when closing the menu
[*] Fixed an issue where the SFX was not playing for some burst fire weapons
[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] General stability improvements on all platforms 
[*] SRM, SRM Artemis, and Streak SRM ammo increased to 150 rounds per ton (from 90) and 75 rounds per half-ton (from 45)
[*] Added a confirmation prompt when selecting Restart Mission on the pause menu
[*] Fixed an issue where the scan pulse effect was visible while spectating 
[*] Fixed an issue where Star commands could sometimes still be issued when powered down
[*] Fixed an issue where players could sometimes lose repair bay capabilities 
[*] Fixed an issue where the detection radius for scannable interaction traces could be too large, causing them to temporarily obstruct interaction with other nearby scannables
[*] Fixed an issue where the mission boundary lines would disappear when using night vision
[*] Fixed an issue where you could fire weapon groups 2-6 while the radial menu is open
[/list]

UI
[list]
[*] The Barracks SimPod terminal will now flash until it has been opened for the first time, to help resolve an issue where the feature wasn’t apparent
[*] Increased the maximum horizontal Custom Safe Zone range when using an ultrawide aspect ratio, to better support triple-monitor setups
[*] Note: Max Safe Zone may still not be sufficient for certain setups, this will be addressed in a future update
[*] Fixed an issue with the Repair Screen Technician panel when using an ultrawide aspect ratio
[*] Updated the pilot skill upgrade menu to show available currency
[*] Updated the active probe element on the HUD so it no longer refers to it as BAP
[*] MechLab now properly greys out options when the user has no 'Mechs
[*] Adjusted the transitions when backing out of missions in Mission Central
[*] Fixed the scroll prompt on the Artbook menu
[/list]

Settings
[list]
[*] Reverted the change that removed the ability to unbind primary KBM actions
[*] Any in-HUD button prompt that corresponds to an unbound action will now display an ‘unbound’ icon in the HUD, instead of a ‘Not bound!’ text string that previously caused issues with overlap

[*] Fixed an issue where custom bindings could reset between game sessions for PC

notes.title: Hotfix #2 Preview
notes.content:
Greetings MechWarriors,

First off we want to say a huge thankyou to all of our players. We are here and we are listening. 

We hope Hotfix 1 addressed a lot of the performance issues that players reported.
We are working on Hotfix 2 right now and we're almost done, our ETA is early next week.  Hotfix 2 continues with performance and coop fixes along with many others – check them all out in detail below. 
Thank you for your support!

-The MechWarrior 5: Clans Team

[h2]HOTFIX #2 Details[/h2]

Fixed Issues:
[h3]Co-Op[/h3]
o	Fixed a bug where clients would sometimes be stuck in the fade to black state after using a repair bay
o	Adjusted the position of the Union takeoff in ‘Pirate’s Bay'
o	Fixed an issue for clients in ‘A World on Fire’ where an enemy 'Mech would disappear briefly during a sequence
o	Fixed a replication issue with the gate generators on ‘Kishi Kaisei’
o	Fixed a replication bug where clients could not walk through certain wall assets destroyed by other clients in ‘A World on Fire’
o	Fixed a bug where the mission area would close off before all players have left in ‘Hold the Line’
o	Fixed a bug where the small gate in ‘Jaguar’s Down' would not open for clients
o	Fixed a client bug where they could not see Chassis Milestones
o	Fixed a Co-Op bug where users can join mid-mission without a HUD
o	Fixed an occurrence where clients can start a mission with the Scan Mode prompt flashing
o	Fixed a rare instance where an enemy would not appear in ‘Smuggler's Den'
[h3]Campaign Missions[/h3]
o	Fixed a salvage crate in ‘Combat Patrol’ that was giving the incorrect rewards
o	Fixed an issue on ‘The Golden Forge’ where some mechs were temporarily indestructible 
o	Fixed the Union takeoff sequence in ‘Inspection Duty’
o	Fixed a bug where certain enemy ‘Mechs would not target you in 'A World on Fire’
o	Adjusted objectives at the start of ‘Kishi Kaisei’ so they can no longer be missed
o	Changed all ally ‘Mechs in 'Traffickers’ to use the Beta Galaxy camo pattern
o	Reduced the chances saKhan Weaver would get caught on terrain in ‘Pirate’s Bay'
o	The host is now the only one able to make the choice in ‘Reckoning’
o	Fixed the ‘Mech cockpit during the intro of 'A World on Fire’
o	Reduced the chances of critical explosion on the boss in ‘Kishi Kaisei’
o	Fixed Jayden’s helmet in his communication pips in the first mission 
o	Added the proper pilot names when targeting allies in ‘Kishi Kaisei’
[h3]Art[/h3]
o	Improved the texture of the large trees on Huntress
o	Adjusted the flamer VFX orientation so the origin point appears correct
[h3]Audio[/h3]
o	Fixed an audio issue where sound was temporarily ducked at the start of the first mission
o	Fixed an instance where Naomi would repeat the same line twice in a row in ‘No Stone Unturned’
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
o	Increased the SRM ammo values up to 150 rounds per ton
o	Buffed the Corsair on ‘No Stone Unturned’
o	Added a confirmation prompt when selecting Restart Mission on the pause menu
o	Disabled the ability to use scan while spectating 
o	Removed the ability to order commands when your 'Mech is shut down
o	Fixed a bug where players can sometimes lose repair bay capabilities 
o	Adjusted the scannable object radiuses to be more accurate 
o	Fixed a bug where the mission boundary lines would disappear when using night vision
o	Fixed a bug where you could fire weapon groups 2-6 while the radial menu is open
[h3]UI[/h3]
o	Adjusted the technician panel on the repair screen on ultrawide aspect ratios
o	Updated the pilot skill upgrade menu to show available currency
o	Updated the active probe element on the HUD
o	Mechlab how properly greys out options when the user has no 'Mechs
o	Adjusted the transitions when backing out of missions in Mission Central
o	Reduced the flickering of the 'Mech in the Mechlab and Marketplace while navigating menus and performing actions
o	Adjusted the safe zone width to work better with triple monitors
o	Fixed the scroll prompt on the Artbook menu
[h3]Settings[/h3]
o	Fixed a joystick control bug where invert Y-Axis would instead invert X-Axis after applying
o	Fixed instances where the spacebar key to apply changes would not function
o	Fixed a bug where the Mirror Paper Doll option would not apply until you restarted a mission
[h3]Localization[/h3]
o	Major update across the board for Japanese language 
o	Fixed the overlapping/out of bounds text on several screens in Russian
o	Fixed the translation for ‘general’ in the Marketplace and Mech Bay in Japanese
o	Fixed the spacing on some settings menu prompts in German

We’re currently working on these fixes and expect them to be in Hotfix 2 although not confirmed yet:
•	More performance improvements
•	Add an option in Co-Op to allow clients to select the pilot they want to play and swap pilots
•	Fixed a Co-Op bug where users were stuck as other pilots when starting a new campaign after playing a Co-Op session
•	Fixed a Co-Op issue where clients would view stuttering with other players
•	Fixed a bug where key bindings would be changed without applying them
•	Fixes for missing audio in pause menu
•	Fixes for audio on burst fire weapons
•	Fix for weapon group audio being too quiet
•	Fix for DLSS option permanently greying itself out under rare conditions

We heard you didn’t like this – so we reverted it
•	Users should not be able to unbind Primary KBM input actions. (But you will have the unbound issue if you do this)

Other issues:
•	We heard some players are experiencing audio issues in cinematics – we’re looking into this and will fix as soon as we can.
•	We heard that lower end AMD cards are having driver issues – so we’re reaching out to AMD to try and get a solution as quickly as possible.

Until Hotfix 2 drops here are some workarounds for 2 controller issues:

For controls changes not saving after game restart:
After changing the controls to your preference, close the game.
Open File Explorer
Click the address bar at the top
Copy-paste the following line and hit Enter:
%localappdata%\MW5Clans\Saved\Config\Windows\
%localappdata%\MW5Clans\Saved\Config\WinGDK\ (for Game Pass and Microsoft Store)
Right-click on the GameUserSettings.ini file and select Properties
Under the General tab check Read-only and click OK.

For not being able to invert Joystick on Y axis:
Open File Explorer
Click the address bar at the top
Copy-paste the following line and hit Enter:
%localappdata%\MW5Clans\Saved\Config\Windows\
%localappdata%\MW5Clans\Saved\Config\WinGDK\ (for Game Pass and Microsoft Store)
Use Notepad to open GameUserSetting.ini
Edit the following line to say True:
InvertJoystickYAxis=True

notes.title: MW5: CLANS Hot fix #1
notes.content:
MECHWARRIOR 5: CLANS - HOTFIX #1 PATCH NOTES

Greeting MechWarriors!

We hope you are enjoying your experience so far with MechWarrior 5: Clans! A hotfix just went live, and here are the details in what was included. We're already hard at work on Hotfix #2, so please keep sending us your feedback, we're watching and listening!

Thank you for your support, and now back to the Invasion!

-MechWarrior 5: Clans Team

PATCH NOTES


CO-OP
Fixed a Co-op issue where clients could not see the Gazelle in 'Inspection Duty'
Fixed an issue for clients where the Leopard and Union Dropships would not animate in ‘Inspection Duty’
Fixed issues for clients where doors would not replicate properly in various missions
Fixed Co-op issues where capture circles would be present before or after objectives in various mission
Fixed a Co-op issue where clients would see an extra Union Dropship in 'Heir to the Dragon'
Fixed a client issue where the garage scanning was not being replicated in ‘Pacification’
Fixed a client issue where the Dropship takeoff would not replicate in ‘Pirate’s Bay’
Fixed a Co-op issue where the Gazelle would not replicate properly for clients in ‘No Holds Barred’
Fixed several issues with the HUD command panel for clients

CAMPAIGN MISSIONS
Replaced the Hero Griffin GRF-1E from ‘Baiting the Hook’
Cleaned up the final objectives and extraction icon in ‘Combat Patrol’
Fixed instances where allies can get stuck outside the gate in ‘Pirate’s Bay’

CONSOLES
XSX XSS Memory Improvements
Fixed issues with unlocking several trophies on PS5
Fixed a console progression blocker in the mission ‘A World on Fire’

VFX 
Adjusted the giant explosion in 'Touchdown'
Improved the explosion effect at the end of ‘Trial of Position’
Added additional water effects on bridges in several missions

AUDIO
Improved and adjusted many of Mia’s Banter dialogue
Improved Mia’s dialogue quality in the first Huntress mission
Added a mission Jayden line in ‘No Stone Unturned’
Fixed bugs where the overheat SFX would not always play
Removed a characters incorrect banter dialogue lines

GAMEPLAY
Fixed a bug where the target box would go missing when overheating and going into the Battlegrid
Fixed a bug where night vision carried over to the following mission
Adjusted AI so they can better execute repair bay orders
Fixed a bug where unlocked melee weapons could not be equipped to hand actuators
Fixed an issue where sometimes after using a repair bay the users HUD will disappear 
Improved Mechbay warning and error messages
Improved collision on some tree assets

UI
Fixed a bug in the Marketplace where controller users could not navigate the Sell menu
Fixed instances where restricted equipment could be selectable 
Added a warning prompt when attempting to sell all 'Mechs
Fixed cut off icons in the splash screen
Adjusted the settings menu so users are unable to unbind primary KBM input actions
Fixed a bug where the ESC key would no longer function
Fixed a bug where you are able to interact with elements under the Private Policy/EULA pop-ups
Fixed flickering in the notifications menu when interacting and scrolling
Fixed controller Icons when using a PS5 Controller

PERFORMANCE
Improved performance/framerate with cockpit view in many levels
Improved performance in Mission Central
Reduced hitching in loading screens

CINEMATICS
Improved Yuichi’s hair in ‘A Cause Worth Fighting For’
Adjusted the length of the cinematic 'No Matter the Cost'

LOCALIZATION
Adjusted the Timber Wolf notification in Japanese
